about: Candidate sounds and music for Frontline Atlas. Real recordings and music made by people; no AI or code-generated audio. Licences are CC0 or CC BY only (no NC, ND or SA). Play them in listen.html.
processing: Silence trimmed; loudness normalised (BS.1770 integrated) to about -16 LUFS for sound effects and -20 LUFS for music, peaks capped at -1 dBFS; encoded as Ogg Opus.

categories.name: Music: peace and menu
categories.about: Calm, strategic orchestral music for the menu and for peace time.

categories.name: Music: war
categories.about: Tense, building music for when a war is on.

categories.name: Music: heavy fighting
categories.about: Full battle music with drums and brass.

categories.name: Sting: victory
categories.about: Short music for winning the game.

categories.name: Sting: defeat
categories.about: Short music for losing the game.

categories.name: Gunfire at the front
categories.about: Distant rifles and machine guns, for a soft loop under a busy front.
